CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trip_create_finite_scope_allowed(actor uuid, trip uuid, operation uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare gate public.trip_create_activation_gate%rowtype; principal record;instant timestamptz;owner_id oid;
begin
 if session_user<>'otr_trip_create_gateway' or current_user<>'postgres' or actor is null or operation is null then return false;end if;
 select oid into owner_id from pg_roles where rolname=current_user;
 select * into principal from pg_roles where rolname='otr_trip_create_gateway';
 if not found or not principal.rolcanlogin or principal.rolconnlimit<>1 or principal.rolvaliduntil is null
 or principal.rolsuper or principal.rolcreatedb or principal.rolcreaterole or principal.rolinherit or principal.rolbypassrls or principal.rolreplication
 or exists(select 1 from pg_auth_members m where (m.roleid=principal.oid or m.member=principal.oid) and not (m.roleid=principal.oid and m.member=owner_id and m.admin_option and not m.inherit_option and not m.set_option))
 or not exists(select 1 from pg_class c where c.oid='public.trip_create_activation_gate'::regclass and c.relowner=owner_id and c.relrowsecurity and not c.relforcerowsecurity)
 or exists(select 1 from pg_policy where polrelid='public.trip_create_activation_gate'::regclass)
 or exists(select 1 from pg_class c cross join lateral aclexplode(c.relacl) a where c.oid='public.trip_create_activation_gate'::regclass and (a.grantee<>owner_id or a.is_grantable))
 or exists(select 1 from pg_shdepend where refclassid='pg_authid'::regclass and refobjid=principal.oid and deptype='o')
 or exists(select 1 from pg_class c cross join lateral aclexplode(c.relacl) a where a.grantee=principal.oid)
 or exists(select 1 from pg_attribute c cross join lateral aclexplode(c.attacl) a where a.grantee=principal.oid)
 or exists(select 1 from pg_namespace n cross join lateral aclexplode(n.nspacl) a where a.grantee=principal.oid and (n.nspname<>'public' or a.privilege_type<>'USAGE' or a.is_grantable))
 or exists(select 1 from pg_database d cross join lateral aclexplode(d.datacl) a where a.grantee=principal.oid)
 or exists(select 1 from pg_tablespace t cross join lateral aclexplode(t.spcacl) a where a.grantee=principal.oid)
 or exists(select 1 from pg_proc p cross join lateral aclexplode(p.proacl) a where a.grantee=principal.oid and (a.privilege_type<>'EXECUTE' or a.is_grantable or p.oid not in (
  'public.trip_create_command(uuid,uuid,uuid,text,text,date,date)'::regprocedure,
  'public.trip_create_command(uuid,uuid,uuid,jsonb)'::regprocedure,
  'public.trip_create_result(uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure,
  'public.trip_core_finite_scope_allowed(uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure,
  'public.trip_create_finite_scope_allowed(uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)))
 then return false;end if;
 select * into gate from public.trip_create_activation_gate where singleton for share;
 instant:=clock_timestamp();
 return coalesce(gate.enabled and actor=gate.actor_account_id and operation=gate.operation_id
  and (trip=gate.trip_id or trip is null)
  and instant>=gate.started_at and instant<gate.expires_at
  and principal.rolvaliduntil>instant and principal.rolvaliduntil<=gate.expires_at,false);
end $function$

constraints.name: finite_core_scope_contract
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((NOT runtime_enabled) AND (enabled_commands = '{}'::text[]) AND (enabled_families = '{}'::text[]) AND (enabled_admission_modes = '{}'::text[]) AND (scope_actor_account_id IS NULL) AND (scope_trip_id IS NULL) AND (scope_started_at IS NULL) AND (scope_expires_at IS NULL)) OR (runtime_enabled AND (enabled_commands = ARRAY['CREATE_ITEM'::text]) AND (enabled_families = ARRAY['P1'::text, 'P3'::text]) AND (enabled_admission_modes = ARRAY['MANUAL'::text]) AND (scope_actor_account_id IS NOT NULL) AND (scope_trip_id IS NOT NULL) AND (scope_started_at IS NOT NULL) AND (scope_expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND isfinite(scope_started_at) AND isfinite(scope_expires_at) AND (scope_expires_at > scope_started_at) AND (scope_expires_at <= (scope_started_at + '00:15:00'::interval)))))

constraints.name: trip_create_gate_request_version
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((NOT enabled) AND (actor_account_id IS NULL) AND (trip_id IS NULL) AND (operation_id IS NULL) AND (request_payload IS NULL) AND (started_at IS NULL) AND (expires_at IS NULL)) OR (enabled AND (actor_account_id IS NOT NULL) AND (trip_id IS NOT NULL) AND (operation_id IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(request_payload) = 'object'::text) AND ((request_payload ->> 'tripId'::text) = (trip_id)::text) AND ((((request_payload - ARRAY['tripId'::text, 'name'::text, 'destination'::text, 'startDate'::text, 'endDate'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (request_payload ?& ARRAY['tripId'::text, 'name'::text, 'destination'::text, 'startDate'::text, 'endDate'::text]) AND (octet_length((request_payload)::text) <= 2048)) OR (((request_payload -> 'formatVersion'::text) = '2'::jsonb) AND ((request_payload - ARRAY['formatVersion'::text, 'tripId'::text, 'name'::text, 'destination'::text, 'destinations'::text, 'startDate'::text, 'endDate'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (request_payload ?& ARRAY['formatVersion'::text, 'tripId'::text, 'name'::text, 'destination'::text, 'destinations'::text, 'startDate'::text, 'endDate'::text]) AND (octet_length((request_payload)::text) <= 131072))) AND (started_at IS NOT NULL) AND (expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND isfinite(started_at) AND isfinite(expires_at) AND (expires_at > started_at) AND (expires_at <= (started_at + '00:15:00'::interval)))) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: trip_metadata_gate_request_version
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((NOT enabled) AND (actor_account_id IS NULL) AND (trip_id IS NULL) AND (operation_id IS NULL) AND (request_payload IS NULL) AND (started_at IS NULL) AND (expires_at IS NULL)) OR (enabled AND (actor_account_id IS NOT NULL) AND (trip_id IS NOT NULL) AND (operation_id IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(request_payload) = 'object'::text) AND (request_payload ?& ARRAY['formatVersion'::text, 'operationId'::text, 'tripId'::text, 'before'::text, 'after'::text, 'expectedMetadataRevision'::text]) AND ((request_payload - ARRAY['formatVersion'::text, 'operationId'::text, 'tripId'::text, 'before'::text, 'after'::text, 'expectedMetadataRevision'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND ((((request_payload -> 'formatVersion'::text) = '2'::jsonb) AND (octet_length((request_payload)::text) <= 8192)) OR (((request_payload -> 'formatVersion'::text) = '3'::jsonb) AND (octet_length((request_payload)::text) <= 262144))) AND ((request_payload ->> 'operationId'::text) = (operation_id)::text) AND ((request_payload ->> 'tripId'::text) = (trip_id)::text) AND (started_at IS NOT NULL) AND (expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND isfinite(started_at) AND isfinite(expires_at) AND (expires_at > started_at) AND (expires_at <= (started_at + '00:15:00'::interval)))) IS TRUE))
